entries: Choose a damage type other than Force. You and your allies in the aura have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen type.

name: Wicker Token
entries: You can weave wicker tokens that carry a touch of your magic. When you finish a long rest, you can create a number of tokens equal to your proficiency bonus. The tokens are Tiny objects (AC 5; HP 1; immunity to poison and psychic damage). The tokens vanish when you finish your next long rest.
You can cast spells with a range of touch on a creature carrying one of your tokens while the two of you are on the same plane of existence.

name: Wicker Token
entries: You can weave wicker tokens that carry a touch of your magic. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can create a number of tokens equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. The tokens are Tiny objects (AC 5; HP 1; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage). The tokens vanish when you finish your next {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You can cast spells with a range of touch on a creature carrying one of your tokens while the two of you are on the same plane of existence.

name: Wicker Zenith
entries: Your wicker effigies reach the pinnacle of their power. At the start of your turn, you can change your effigy's aura to a different one. Additionally, all the auras grow stronger in the following ways.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries: The fire damage increases to {@dice 3d8} plus your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Soothe
entries: When you or your allies start a turn in the aura, the {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} condition (target's choice) ends on it.

entries.name: Ward
entries: Choose an ability. You and each of your allies within the aura have advantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

name: Wicker Zenith
entries: Your wicker effigies reach the pinnacle of their power. At the start of your turn, you can change your effigy's aura to a different one. Additionally, all the auras grow stronger in the following ways.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries: The Fire damage increases to {@dice 3d8} plus your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Soothe
entries: When you or your allies start a turn in the aura, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (target's choice) ends on it.

entries.name: Ward
entries: Choose an ability. You and each of your allies within the aura have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

name: Wickerbone Behemoth
entries: You can unleash the vicious natural powers held amidst your flesh. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while you aren't wearing armor or holding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you can expend one use of your Wild Shape to awaken Nature's anger and turn into a behemoth. A deer skull, wooden skin, goat hooves, or other such natural gifts overtake your body. For the next 10 minutes, or until you use your {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid|XPHB|2|XPHB} feature, you gain the following benefits:

items: Each arm counts as a {@item Club|XPHB} under the effect of the {@spell Shillelagh|XPHB} spell, and you can use their mastery property. You can otherwise use your hands normally to manipulate objects or cast spells, but you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) checks made with them.
You are under the effect of the {@spell Barkskin|XPHB} spell (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required).

Whenever a creature damages you with an attack, your skin splinters and each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you takes {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage. Starting at Druid level 10, this damage increases to {@damage 2d4}.

The stress of battle stimulates your organism to fight and survive. At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage taken since the start of your previous turn, up to a maximum of five times your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. This regeneration doesn't work if you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition.

name: Wild Recovery
entries: You gain the ability to recover using the wild, bestial magic that courses through you. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus your Druid level. This healing increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach Druid levels 10 ({@dice 3d6} plus your Druid level) and 14 ({@dice 4d6} plus your Druid level).

name: Wind Shot
entries: When you reach 6th level, you gain the ability to mimic the sheep dragon's wind pistol, blasting enemies with powerful gale forces at a distance. When you make an unarmed strike, you can instead choose to make a special attack, firing a compressed blast of air from your mouth. This ranged weapon attack has a range of 60 feet, and it uses the same attack bonus and damage die as your unarmed strike.

Additionally, when you hit a target with this special attack, you can choose to spend 1 ki point to force the target to make a Strength saving throw against your ki save DC. On a failed save, the target is knocked {@condition prone} or pushed 10 feet away from you (your choice).

name: Winds of Revival
entries: Starting at 14th level, the spirit of Obojima comes to your aid in your times of greatest need. When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you instead regain half of your hit points and are lifted to your feet amidst a turbulent tempest of petals.

You can then immediately use your reaction to send a wave of concussive wind sweeping out from you. Each creature in a 10-foot radius centered on you must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be pushed 15 feet away from you and suffer {@dice 2d8} slashing damage.
Once you use this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can use it again.

name: Windswept
entries: By 7th level, the wind clears a path for you and ushers you forward. Your walking speed increases by 5 feet, you ignore any movement penalty caused by strong wind, and you can't be pushed because of strong wind against your will.
In addition, you have resistance to cold damage, and you're acclimated to high altitudes, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

name: Winter Trapper
entries: {@i Employ Icy Snares to Render Your Quarry Frozen and Helpless}

Winter Trappers are masters of control and keep both their adversaries and quarries helpless and at bay. Originating from the Everglacier, these trained hunters are experts at staying upright when others would surely fall, and have learned how to use magic and acrobatics to keep both themselves and their allies out of harm's reach.

name: Winter Trapper Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Winter Trapper Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

name: Wise Leechcraft
entries: Also starting at 3rd level, you add your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1) to your Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) checks, to the hit points regained for each Hit Die spent by any creature you choose as the target of your {@classFeature Hands of a Healer|Scholar|TLotRR|2|TLotRR}, and to the number of uses of your {@classFeature Rhymes of Lore|Scholar|TLotRR|1|TLotRR}. The Lore dice granted by these additional uses can only be added to Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) checks.
In addition, when a creature would roll a Lore die it gained from you on an Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) check, it instead uses the highest number possible for the die.

name: Wise Words
entries: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance} and {@skill Persuasion} skills. Additionally, whenever you roll an ability check using a Charisma-based skill, you can use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier.

name: Witch Hunter's Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage to the target. If the creature is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on a spell, you deal an extra {@damage 2d8} Force damage instead. At Cleric level 14, the extra Force damage increases to {@dice 2d8}, or {@dice 3d8} if the creature is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on a spell.

If a creature fails its saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} as a result of taking damage from this feature, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the extra Force damage dealt.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Witch Hunter's Strike
entries: At 1st level, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an additional {@damage 1d8} force damage. If the creature is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, you deal an additional {@damage 2d8} force damage instead. If a creature fails its saving throw to maintain {@status concentration} as a result of taking damage from this feature, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the extra force damage dealt by this attack. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once), regaining all uses upon completion of a long rest.
At 14th level, this damage increases to {@dice 2d8}, and {@dice 3d8} if the creature is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell.

name: Witch Mark
entries: When you finish a long rest, you can imbue magic into a nonmagical Tiny object you're holding. Choose one warlock spell you know that has a casting time of 1 action. A creature holding the marked object can take an action to cast the spell (using your Charisma modifier, spell attack bonus, or spell save DC). The mark fades when the spell is cast from it or when you finish a long rest.

name: Witch Mark
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can imbue magic into a nonmagical Tiny object you're holding. Choose one of your prepared Warlock spells that has a casting time of an action. A creature holding the marked object can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast the spell (using your Charisma modifier, spell attack bonus, or spell save DC). The mark fades when the spell is cast from it or when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Witching Arrows
entries: You gain the ability to imbue curses into your arrows. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged attack using a {@item Longbow|XPHB} or {@item Shortbow|XPHB}, you can expend a level 1+ spell slot to choose one of the following effects (no action required). The listed damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each spell slot above 1.

entries.name: Arcing Shot
entries: Electricity crackles around the arrow. Make a ranged attack roll with the same weapon against a second creature within 30 feet of the first that is also within your range. Each creature hit takes {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage.

entries.name: Entangling Shot
entries: The wooden shaft of the arrow sprouts tiny green leaves. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes the damage only. A {@condition Restrained|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Hexing Shot
entries: The magic surrounding your arrow clouds the mind of your target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage and gains the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (your choice). The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Viper Shot
entries: The arrow transforms into a hissing serpent. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

name: Wood Wose
entries: As a bonus action, or as part of casting {@spell Shillelagh|phb}, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to suffuse yourself with the power of the primordial woods, gaining the following benefits.

entries.name: Bark Bulwark
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

entries.name: Elderwood Sap
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using the weapon enhanced by {@spell Shillelagh|phb}, the target is coated in Elderwood sap until the start of your next turn. While coated, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you.

entries.name: Oaken Resolve
entries: You have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
This effect lasts for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), are {@condition incapacitated}, or die.

name: Wood Wose
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or as part of casting {@spell Shillelagh|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to suffuse yourself with the power of the primordial woods, gaining the following benefits.

entries.name: Bark Bulwark
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

entries.name: Elderwood Sap
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using the weapon enhanced by {@spell Shillelagh|XPHB}, the target is coated in Elderwood sap until the start of your next turn. While coated, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets other than you.

entries.name: Oaken Resolve
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
This effect lasts for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or die.

name: Words of Command
entries: At 7th level, when you roll a Lore die and add the number rolled to an ability check using a skill other than {@skill Medicine}, you can obtain a magical success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Words of Guard and Guiding
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to make a Charisma check or take the {@action Stabilize a Creature||Help} action. In addition, whenever you use the {@action Help} action to aid an ally in attacking a creature, the target of the attack can be within 30 feet of you rather than within 5 feet of you, if the ally can hear and understand you.

name: Work in Progress
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can replace one of your prepared spells with a new spell from the Artificer, Cleric, or Wizard spell list. This spell counts as an Artificer spell for you.

name: Wretched Bloodline Sorcery
entries: {@i Wield Your Curse Like a Weapon}

With every promise whispered to a fairy, every contract signed with a devil, and every pact made with the dead, there's a chance someone doesn't keep their end of the bargain. The vengeance of immortal beings lasts much longer than one lifetime, and the lingering magic of these curses can affect the mortal's descendants.

These inherited magical afflictions may manifest as a plague, deformity, or aversion to the sun. In such families, children may be born who learn to master the latent magic within their inherited curses, turning their banes into personal boons—these sorcerers are known collectively as the Wretched.

name: Wretched Curse
entries: You suffer from a curse inherited from an ancestor who failed to uphold their end of a bargain with an otherworldly power. Choose one of the following curses that was passed down to you.

entries.name: Hulking
entries: Your ancestor was cursed with a hulking frame. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to escape notice by moving quietly. In addition, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. Finally, you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

entries.name: Nocturnal
entries: Your ancestor was cursed to shun the light of day. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight while you are in sunlight. In addition, you can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Plaguebearer
entries: Your ancestor was cursed with physical symptoms of a plague. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks made to influence an {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself. In addition, you are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

name: Wyrm's Blessing
entries: You can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to cast {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} or {@spell Protection from Energy|XPHB} on yourself rather than expending a spell slot. When you cast either spell in this way, the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. This spell ends early if you cast that spell again, have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or die.

name: You Die on My Command!
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of you who can hear you drops to 0 hit points without being killed outright, you can use your reaction to shout an order at them, causing them to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this reaction, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
